# lib tree 6f6b812d42131a3b0ca3b8f5e3ee53e2a65d49d2), Plurimath::Latex::Parse, exported with
# Ruby 4.0.1 / Parsanol 1.3.130.
# data/latex-atoms.json sha256:405440c7f5e90a866e5b36d8145e547572c8c67779984726bcc52c38972950c9
# legacy LaTeX sources:

#   lib/plurimath/latex/parser.rb sha256:0a4eac1dbc63c44f57344cb2beab04f93f523e8492ebd3dea7dbbe89cd6d85e5
#   lib/plurimath/latex/parse.rb sha256:2461135905bb1d3ca0327312aeb458c1243f301c63b293e40b1e9becaaa788c8
#   lib/plurimath/base_number_prefix.rb sha256:e156362859cb15cc19d45a304331df5d4e3e6c82a05eb1da32d5805645977e82
#   lib/plurimath/latex/constants.rb sha256:1e3a702084614859cace564f889a1b1909b6559ffacdf7458fe4a2a4c7b9ea61
#   lib/plurimath/latex/utility.rb sha256:868a19dab269c5295fc95b63b4c243db1d435396ead2fd5ab0ea127195ab76fc
#   lib/plurimath/latex/transform.rb sha256:0280d473fa72498a2d7e2b4e7b092a63ddba69e56f14f2b69494105fa66d38a9
#
# Syntax only: the grammar reproduces the raw tree of
# Plurimath::Latex::Parse#parse(text), where text is
# Plurimath::Latex::Parser.new(input).text (see docs/parser-contract.adoc).
# No model and no transform.
#
# Transcription: every Parsanol Entity (rule) is one rule here, under its
# Plurimath name; every other atom is written inline, mechanically:
#   str("x")      "x"          (non-printable / non-ASCII chars as %x)
#   a >> b        a b          a | b      a / b
#   .as(:n)       (X) as n     .maybe     [X]
#   .repeat       *(X)         .repeat(1) 1*(X)
#   .absent?      !(X)         .present?  &(X)
# Long alternatives are split into rules of their own. A rule reference
# only adds an Entity wrapper and PEG choice is associative, so no tree
# changes. In order:
#   - an inline alternative of more than 32 branches becomes <rule>_alt<k>;
#   - in a rule specialised per decimal marker (below), each maximal run
#     of 4 or more top-level branches that does not reach the
#     marker becomes one shared rule <rule>_run<k>, so the
#     Constants.symbols_constants branches inside symbol_class_commands
#     are written once, not once per marker;
#   - a rule-level alternative of more than 16 branches becomes a tree
#     of rules <rule>_part<k> of at most 16 branches each, which keeps
#     the number of order-lint warnings linear.
#
# Constructs without a direct PARG form (each one a fixed table in the
# generator; anything outside the tables stops generation):
#   match(re)     the class of characters the native engine's regex
#                 matches, as %x ranges (see the helper rules at the end).
#                 match(/\s/) is Unicode White_Space there, wider than
#                 Ruby's /\s/; preprocessing leaves only ASCII outside
#                 \mbox and \text groups, where the two agree.
#   .as("\\\\")   capture names must be identifiers: written `as row_break`.
#                 Plurimath::Latex::Parse#parse renames the :"\\\\" key
#                 to the String "\\\\"; Latexmath renames :row_break to
#                 that String, which gives the same tree.
#   decimal_marker
#                 str(Utility.string_to_html_entity(configuration.decimal))
#                 is fixed per parser instance, so the grammar is
#                 specialised per marker: every rule that reaches the
#                 marker is emitted once per marker with a __<entry>
#                 suffix. Entries:
#     entry dot: decimal U+002E, locale (default), matched as "." (11927 atoms)
#     entry comma: decimal U+002C, locale sr-Cyrl-ME, matched as "," (11927 atoms)
#     entry arabic: decimal U+066B, locale ar, matched as "٫" (11927 atoms)
#                 Specialised rules:
#     array_args begining binary_functions ending expression intermediate_exp
#     iteration left_right limits math_operators optional_args over_class
#     power_base sequence sqrt_arg subscript supscript symbol_class_commands
#     symbol_text_or_integer

#                 per process (@@expression). If a process parses with one
#                 marker and later with another, commands from that table
#                 keep the first marker inside their arguments. This
#                 grammar implements the fresh-process behaviour: one
#                 marker throughout.
#
# Bindings: each entry starts at latex_tree__<entry>, which captures the
# legacy root as latex_tree, and declares one structural binding,
# `latex_tree -> latex_tree (raw)`, that carries the whole raw tree
# unchanged. The bindings name no model fields; those belong to the
# typed language model.

  expression__dot = iteration__dot expression__dot / iteration__dot / (iteration__dot) as dividend "\\over" (iteration__dot) as divisor [expression__dot]
  expression__comma = iteration__comma expression__comma / iteration__comma / (iteration__comma) as dividend "\\over" (iteration__comma) as divisor [expression__comma]
  expression__arabic = iteration__arabic expression__arabic / iteration__arabic / (iteration__arabic) as dividend "\\over" (iteration__arabic) as divisor [expression__arabic]
  iteration__dot = (sequence__dot) as sequence (iteration__dot) as expression / sequence__dot [expression__dot]
  iteration__comma = (sequence__comma) as sequence (iteration__comma) as expression / sequence__comma [expression__comma]
  iteration__arabic = (sequence__arabic) as sequence (iteration__arabic) as expression / sequence__arabic [expression__arabic]
  sequence__dot = sequence_part1__dot / sequence_part2__dot
  sequence__comma = sequence_part1__comma / sequence_part2__comma
  sequence__arabic = sequence_part1__arabic / sequence_part2__arabic
  sequence_part1__dot = {
      (limits__dot) as limits
    / ((binary_functions__dot) as binary_functions power (sequence__dot) as supscript) as power
    / ((binary_functions__dot) as binary_functions base (sequence__dot) as subscript) as base
    / binary_functions__dot
    / (slash ("rule") as rule ([sqrt_arg__dot]) as first_value ([intermediate_exp__dot]) as second_value ([intermediate_exp__dot]) as third_value) as binary
    / over_class__dot power (intermediate_exp__dot) as supscript
    / over_class__dot base (intermediate_exp__dot) as subscript
    / over_class__dot
    / (left_right__dot) as left_right power (intermediate_exp__dot) as supscript
    / (left_right__dot) as left_right base (intermediate_exp__dot) as subscript
    / (left_right__dot) as left_right
    / slash ("substack") as substack intermediate_exp__dot
    / (array_begin array_args__dot (expression__dot) as table_data ending__dot) as environment
    / (begining__dot (expression__dot) as table_data ending__dot) as environment
    / (slash environment intermediate_exp__dot) as table_data
    / power_base__dot
  }
  sequence_part1__comma = {
      (limits__comma) as limits
    / ((binary_functions__comma) as binary_functions power (sequence__comma) as supscript) as power
    / ((binary_functions__comma) as binary_functions base (sequence__comma) as subscript) as base
    / binary_functions__comma
    / (slash ("rule") as rule ([sqrt_arg__comma]) as first_value ([intermediate_exp__comma]) as second_value ([intermediate_exp__comma]) as third_value) as binary
    / over_class__comma power (intermediate_exp__comma) as supscript
    / over_class__comma base (intermediate_exp__comma) as subscript
    / over_class__comma
    / (left_right__comma) as left_right power (intermediate_exp__comma) as supscript
    / (left_right__comma) as left_right base (intermediate_exp__comma) as subscript
    / (left_right__comma) as left_right
    / slash ("substack") as substack intermediate_exp__comma
    / (array_begin array_args__comma (expression__comma) as table_data ending__comma) as environment
    / (begining__comma (expression__comma) as table_data ending__comma) as environment
    / (slash environment intermediate_exp__comma) as table_data
    / power_base__comma
  }
  sequence_part1__arabic = {
      (limits__arabic) as limits
    / ((binary_functions__arabic) as binary_functions power (sequence__arabic) as supscript) as power
    / ((binary_functions__arabic) as binary_functions base (sequence__arabic) as subscript) as base
    / binary_functions__arabic
    / (slash ("rule") as rule ([sqrt_arg__arabic]) as first_value ([intermediate_exp__arabic]) as second_value ([intermediate_exp__arabic]) as third_value) as binary
    / over_class__arabic power (intermediate_exp__arabic) as supscript
    / over_class__arabic base (intermediate_exp__arabic) as subscript
    / over_class__arabic
    / (left_right__arabic) as left_right power (intermediate_exp__arabic) as supscript
    / (left_right__arabic) as left_right base (intermediate_exp__arabic) as subscript
    / (left_right__arabic) as left_right
    / slash ("substack") as substack intermediate_exp__arabic
    / (array_begin array_args__arabic (expression__arabic) as table_data ending__arabic) as environment
    / (begining__arabic (expression__arabic) as table_data ending__arabic) as environment
    / (slash environment intermediate_exp__arabic) as table_data
    / power_base__arabic
  }
  sequence_part2__dot = intermediate_exp__dot / (intermediate_exp__dot) as intermediate_exp (rparen) as symbol
  sequence_part2__comma = intermediate_exp__comma / (intermediate_exp__comma) as intermediate_exp (rparen) as symbol
  sequence_part2__arabic = intermediate_exp__arabic / (intermediate_exp__arabic) as intermediate_exp (rparen) as symbol

      math_operators__dot base (intermediate_exp__dot) as base power (intermediate_exp__dot) as power

  }
  limits__comma = {
      math_operators__comma base (intermediate_exp__comma) as base power (intermediate_exp__comma) as power
    / math_operators__comma power (intermediate_exp__comma) as power base (intermediate_exp__comma) as base
  }
  limits__arabic = {
      math_operators__arabic base (intermediate_exp__arabic) as base power (intermediate_exp__arabic) as power
    / math_operators__arabic power (intermediate_exp__arabic) as power base (intermediate_exp__arabic) as base
  }
  math_operators__dot = (symbol_text_or_integer__dot) as first_value "\\limits"
  math_operators__comma = (symbol_text_or_integer__comma) as first_value "\\limits"
  math_operators__arabic = (symbol_text_or_integer__arabic) as first_value "\\limits"
  symbol_text_or_integer__dot = {
      ("\"") as symbol
    / !(rparen) symbol_class_commands__dot
    / slash math_operators_classes
    / (ascii_letter) as symbols
    / hex_number

  # match("[0-9a-fA-F]")
  hex_digit = %x30-39 / %x41-46 / %x61-66
  # match("[^}]")
  not_rbrace = %x00-7C / %x7E-10FFFF
  # match("(?-mix:\\s)")
  white_space = %x09-0D / %x20 / %x85 / %xA0 / %x1680 / %x2000-200A / %x2028-2029 / %x202F / %x205F / %x3000

  # ---- the tree capture each entry starts from ----
  latex_tree__dot = (expression__dot) as latex_tree
  latex_tree__comma = (expression__comma) as latex_tree
  latex_tree__arabic = (expression__arabic) as latex_tree
}

entry dot: latex_tree__dot
entry comma: latex_tree__comma
entry arabic: latex_tree__arabic

bindings latex_tree__dot {
  latex_tree -> latex_tree (raw)
}

bindings latex_tree__comma {
  latex_tree -> latex_tree (raw)
}

bindings latex_tree__arabic {
  latex_tree -> latex_tree (raw)
